response.sql:
WITH purpose_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(k_symbol, '') as k_symbol,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount
  FROM `order`
  WHERE amount > 2802
  GROUP BY COALESCE(k_symbol, '')
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg
  FROM purpose_averages
)
SELECT 
  pa.k_symbol,
  pa.avg_amount,
  pa.avg_amount - oa.overall_avg as exceeds
FROM purpose_averages pa
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE pa.avg_amount > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY pa.k_symbol

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in k_symbol are treated as the blank purpose code group and converted to empty string for explicit representation
"Simple average of those per-purpose averages" means AVG(avg_amount), weighting each purpose equally regardless of how many orders have that purpose

alternatives.interpretation: Keep NULL values as NULL rather than converting to empty string: use GROUP BY k_symbol (without COALESCE). The computation logic remains identical; only the representation of blanks in output differs.
